messages.speaker: Zoidberg
messages.message: Friends! I noticed something! The 34-hour dwell time? That's not browsing. That's LIVING. These humans are moving in! Why does nobody invite Zoidberg to move in?

messages.speaker: Grandpa Farnsworth
messages.message: Good news, everyone! The sort ratio is 0.3949. In my day we sorted by hand. Uphill. Both ways. Through a snowstorm of untyped nodes. You youngsters have it easy with your anderson localization and your fancy schmancy ternary digits.

messages.speaker: Hermes
messages.message: Form 27B/6: Request to reclassify 288 nodes. Status: PENDING. Required signatures: 0 (this is AGPL, not bureaucracy). Filed anyway because Hermes files EVERYTHING.
